update-read: Read DSM update progress and server-check result
mail-read: Read MailPlus configuration and diagnostic evidence
mail-write: Apply and restore previewed MailPlus SMTP, DKIM and default relay changes
precheck-read: Read DNS, time and proxy settings to explain a failed connection
signin-read: Read sign-in, account protection, firewall, port forwarding, snapshot and encryption-key settings
time-repair: Correct the NAS clock when it is clearly wrong, so sign-in codes keep working
access-read: Read accounts, groups, shared-folder permissions, folder ACLs, application privileges and file-service settings to explain why a user can or cannot open a folder
photos-read: Read Synology Photos, user home and codec settings to explain why photos do not appear
storage-read: Read storage health, SMART schedules and notification enablement
